recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-39237; future changes to the gender-identity value set definition or membership should be handled in the terminology/Gender Harmony source of truth.
issue_request: FHIR-39237 was a Published FHIR-core R5 Patient Administration request to add an "Identifies as Two-Spirit gender" concept to the gender-identity value set. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution did not add the code; it required the definition to say the value set is a minimum set of commonly used values and that jurisdictions or communities are expected and encouraged to use additional relevant gender identity concepts.
initial_application: Commit c81773b01523a9249faed5e940e63e9f3afa10d5 applied the issue by changing source/patient/valueset-gender-identity.xml to the exact minimum-set definition approved in Jira.
additional_context: Commit f3c0d3659cb93c99329c153a85820bb086df832f later removed source/patient/valueset-gender-identity.xml and neighboring Gender Harmony terminology files from core as moved terminology. Current core source has no active gender-identity ValueSet source file, while the Extension Pack genderIdentity extension binds to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/gender-identity. The current terminology.hl7.org ValueSet already contains the FHIR-39237 clarification. Confluence minutes support the Jira disposition and note a Gender Harmony IG follow-up task; no conflicting Zulip or Jira evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing or editing the old core ValueSet file would be incorrect because the current authoritative terminology is outside this core checkout and is already correct.
